Package index

Enumeration

The twenty-five principles as a documented data object, carrying the structural partition of Samkhya-Karika 3, the immediate material cause of each principle, and its membership in the internal organ, the elevenfold set and the subtle body. Every table, diagram and method in the package derives from this object, so the numbering cannot drift between them.

tattvas
The twenty-five tattvas of the Samkhya enumeration

Evolution

The branching derivation of Samkhya-Karika 22 and 25. The eleven organs issue from the sattvic aspect of ahamkara and the five tanmatras from its tamasic aspect, in parallel rather than in sequence, and the gross elements descend from the tanmatras alone. Each step enforces its own causal precondition and preserves the guna triple on the two-simplex.

init_prakriti()
Initialise Prakrti in its primordial equilibrium
evolution_buddhi()
Evolve buddhi, the cosmic intellect
evolution_ahamkara()
Evolve ahamkara, the principle of self-appropriation
evolution_manas()
Evolve manas, the eleventh organ
evolution_indriyas()
Evolve the ten organs of knowledge and action
evolution_tanmatras()
Evolve the five tanmatras
evolution_mahabhutas()
Evolve the five gross elements
samkhya_evolve()
Run the complete evolution of Prakrti

Liberation

The cessation of Prakrti’s activity once discriminative knowledge has arisen in buddhi. Samkhya-Karika 62 denies that anyone is bound, released or a transmigrant, so nothing here alters Purusha.

get_kaivalya()
Attain kaivalya through discriminative knowledge

Doctrinal reference

Reference objects for the doctrines that surround the evolution: the three means of valid knowledge in the karika’s own vocabulary, the eight dispositions of buddhi with the fiftyfold intellectual creation, the eighteen constituents of the subtle body, and the five arguments for the pre-existence of the effect in its cause.

samkhya_pramanas()
The three means of valid knowledge
buddhi_bhavas()
The eight dispositions of buddhi and the fiftyfold intellectual creation
linga_sharira()
The subtle body and its eighteen constituents
satkaryavada()
The doctrine that the effect pre-exists in its cause

Visualisation

Mermaid definitions of the derivation, generated from the enumeration rather than written by hand.

create_samkhya_flowchart()
Diagram of the Samkhya derivation
create_samkhya_flowchart_detailed()
Detailed diagram of the Samkhya derivation
print_samkhya_flowchart()
Render the Samkhya diagram

Methods

Display and diagnostic methods for the classed objects the package returns.

print(<samkhya_state>)
Print a Samkhya evolution state
summary(<samkhya_state>)
Summarise a Samkhya evolution state
plot(<samkhya_state>)
Plot a Samkhya evolution state
print(<summary.samkhya_state>)
Print the summary of a Samkhya evolution state
print(<samkhya_linga>)
Print the subtle body
print(<samkhya_pramana>)
Print the means of valid knowledge
print(<samkhya_bhava>)
Print the dispositions of buddhi
print(<samkhya_satkarya>)
Print the doctrine of the pre-existent effect
